observations: 2014 Journal of Endodontics case report: NaOCl eye burn in endodontist using operating microscope during root-canal treatment.

entities.name: NaOCl occupational eye burn
observations: A 24-year-old endodontist using an operating microscope sustained direct left-eye exposure to 3.5% NaOCl after a pressurized irrigation cannula burst; a corneal ulcer was diagnosed 8 days later, and vision recovered without sequelae by 4 weeks.
